newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Petco issues tender to sell Bunga Kekwa crude.
newsitem.headline: Petco issues tender to sell Bunga Kekwa crude.

text.p: Malaysia's oil trading company has issued a tender to sell the first cargo of Bunga Kekwa crude, said a company source on Wednesday.
The tender was scheduled to be issued early on Tuesday. But communications problems delayed the issue of the tender until late on Tuesday, sources said.
As reported by Reuter on Monday, the tender is for 200-250,000 barrels, loading between 21-31 August. It closes at 1500 hours Kuala Lumpur time (0700 GMT) with validity to 1830 hours on the same day.
The Bunga Kekwa crude field is scheduled to come onstream on 27 July at a rate of 20,000 barrels-per-day, said the source.

The consortium developing the field is made up of Petronas Carigali, with 46.06 percent, Petrovietnam Exploration and Production with 12.5 percent, Canada's International Petroleum Corp with 26.44 percent and Sands Petroleum AB with 15 percent.
